Orbit points at common centered distance sqrt(sum(a_i-a-bar)^2) give unique outer circumcenter and complete sphere contact set by strict Euclidean convexity. For a_i=d+1-2i, A_k=k(d-k), yielding sqrt(d(d-1)), sqrt(d(d^2-1)/3), endpoint ranks. Checked source exact-Fraction code for d=2..12; finite tests do not replace the universal support proof.
